description: This file defines a PHP class named Zone within the Opencart.Catalog.Model.Localisation namespace. The class extends a system engine model and provides methods to retrieve geographical zone data from the database, including getting a specific zone by ID and retrieving zones by country ID, with caching support.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: Model class that handles localising geographical zones, including retrieving zone details by ID or country ID.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Retrieves a specific zone's details from the database using its zone ID, returning an array of zone properties.

methods.name: getZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Fetches all zones associated with a given country ID, utilizing cache for efficiency.
